nodes.t: So let me get this right. The captain plans to steal the team using his own wedding, and our only witness is you, hiding behind a curtain, illegally.
Nobody will believe you. You're the rookie who wants his fiancée. You need proof.

msgs.t: I heard it too. Through the floor.
I'm going to get it on record. Don't try to stop me.
Just win your match tonight. Please. Give my father one reason to keep you.

nodes.n: Saturday. You're back in the eleven because two players have food poisoning. Monarchs against the Falcons again. Kunal is batting with you.

nodes.t: Relax, small town. I'll run you out before Delhi gets you. Saves everyone the paperwork.

nodes.n: Last over. Fourteen to win. Kunal calls you for a single that isn't there. You dive. You make it by a hair. He shrugs at the camera.

moment.title: 14 off 5
moment.desc: Your own captain just tried to run you out. Five balls left. Tanveer Ali again. Fourteen to win.

nodes.n: A six off the last ball. The stadium explodes. Kunal hugs you for the cameras and whispers: "Lucky."
Three short. In the dug-out Kunal tells the reporters you panicked. Somebody in the owner's box throws a glass against the wall.

msgs.t: My father is back from Delhi.
He knows about the balcony. A guard saw the ladder.
He wants to see you. Alone. Now.

nodes.cliff: Harsh Malhotra knows. And he wants you alone.
